Lisa DeBruine and Dale Barr both gave invited keynotes at the 10th annual Summer School on Statistical Methods for Linguistics and Psychology. 
 
Lisa's talk: Power and Simulation 

Slides: https://www.scienceverse.org/talks/2026-power-sim/
 
Abstract: Power analyses help us to plan studies and interpret findings. The statistical power of a specific test depends on the effect size, sample size, and alpha criterion. In this talk, I will cover common mistakes with conducting and reporting power analyses, and present simulation-based methods for conducting power analyses for any inferential test. I will cover fixed effects and mixed effects models, with additional materials at https://debruine.github.io/data-sim-workshops/.
